component-o.description-s: parallel-mode A/D with 96KHz I2S output, sharp roll-off digital filter -- SKU AK5522-IO18: DVDD/I-O at 1.8 V.

cfgpins-ao.1c: CKS3 low (Table 3 mode 2); p6: unused digital inputs to DVSS, never float (p5 Note 1)

cfgpins-ao.2c: PDN active-low reset/power-down, Hi-Z, must not float (p5 Note 1): driven by the MCU (ds-adc_pdn-rx); 100 k to DVSS holds the ADC in power-down while the MCU pin is Hi-Z at boot (not from the datasheet)

cfgpins-ao.3c: CKS1 high: with CKS3/2/0 low, Table 3 mode 2 = master, stereo, MCLK 256fs in, BICK 64fs and LRCK out, fs 8-54 kHz, PLL off

cfgpins-ao.4c: SD low: sharp roll-off digital filter (p5)

cfgpins-ao.5c: PSN high: parallel control mode (p5); no I2C

cfgpins-ao.8c: single-ended input (Figure 87): LINN AC-grounded through 330 nF C0G to AVSS, matching LINP's 330 nF series coupling cap so both inputs see the same source impedance; C0G because the review flagged Class 2 (X5R) dielectric in the audio path. Corner with the single-ended input resistance (p8: 27.3 k typ, 10 k min at 0 dB) is 18 Hz typ, 48 Hz worst case

cfgpins-ao.9c: single-ended input (Figure 87): RINN AC-grounded through 330 nF C0G to AVSS, matching RINP's series cap (see 8c)

cfgpins-ao.11c: VREF: decouple to AVSS with 1 uF (p5 pin 11, p80 item 2)

cfgpins-ao.12c: LOOP left open: PLL off in mode 2 (p6 Handling of Unused Pin: LOOP open); 0.01 uF to AVSS only in a PLL mode

cfgpins-ao.15c: REGAO: AVDD 5 V, the 3.3 V DAC regulator is on (no register to disable it in parallel mode): 10 uF to AVSS (p5 pin 15, p6)

cfgpins-ao.19c: REGDO tied to DVDD: with DVDD at 1.7-1.98 V the internal 1.8 V regulator is bypassed (p5 pin 19, p7 Note 7); no capacitor

cfgpins-ao.25c: exposed pad (2.45 mm, p82 outline): the datasheet does not say where it connects; tied to AVSS, since AVSS and DVSS share one analog ground plane (p80 item 1)

cfgpins-ao.14c: AVDD and DVDD: 10 uF + 0.1 uF each to ground, close to the pins (system connection diagram p79; p80 item 1)

cfgpins-ao.7c: LINP: the source (SPH8878 OUT+, a single-ended analog output) is AC-coupled at this end through a 330 nF C0G series cap (<C>-link); the input is biased internally to the ADC's reference (p80 item 3)

cfgpins-ao.10c: RINP: AC-coupled through a 330 nF C0G series cap (<C>-link), as LINP

io_banks_ao.source-s: AK5522 datasheet 017002311-E-00 (2017/03): p1 Features, p5 pin 17 DVDD / pin 19 REGDO, p7 Note 7

specs-o.io_note-s: DVDD (pin 17) is the only digital supply and sets the I/O level of PDN, MCLK, BICK, LRCK, SDTO and the mode straps; AVDD (pin 14, 3.0-3.6 or 4.5-5.5 V) is independent.

component-o.sku-note-s: I/O-voltage SKU: DVDD = 1.8 V (1.70-1.98 V), so its I2S port, PDN and straps run at 1.8 V. REGDO (pin 19) is tied to DVDD (regulator bypassed), no capacitor. Parallel control mode (CKS2/CKS3 to DVSS, PSN high), so no I2C. AVDD stays 5 V. AK5522 datasheet 017002311-E-00 (2017/03): p1 Features, p5 pin 17 DVDD / pin 19 REGDO, p7 Note 7 DVDD current 13 mA max is the datasheet's fs=96 kHz figure, stated at DVDD 3.3 V only; at 1.8 V the core draws the same current directly instead of through the internal linear regulator, so it bounds the 1.8 V case too.
